title: Query your metrics API in 10 lines of Python
author: Acme Analytics Team
html:
Query your metrics API in 10 lines of Python

Our metrics API returns any dashboard tile as JSON.

import requests
r = requests.get('https://api.acme-analytics.example/v1/metrics/revenue', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer TOKEN'})
print(r.json()['value'])

Responses are cached for 60 seconds, so you can poll safely.
